本頁重點

In short

船對船轉運（旁靠，STS）是兩艘船在海上近距離並靠、不進港就轉移貨物的行為。它本身常是合法的—— 雙拖漁法、海上補給、燃油加注——但也是制裁規避與走私隱匿貨物流向的關鍵手法。 本站以 AIS 時空配對偵測旁靠事件，並區分合法作業與可疑轉運。旁靠是值得研判的線索，並非違法認定。

A ship-to-ship (STS) transfer, or "rendezvous," is two vessels lying alongside at sea to move cargo without entering port. It is often perfectly legal — pair trawling, resupply, bunkering — but it is also a key tactic for sanctions evasion and smuggling to hide where cargo comes from. This site detects STS events via spatio-temporal AIS matching and separates lawful operations from suspicious transfers. An STS event is a lead to investigate, not a legal finding.

  • 偵測方法：找出兩船同時段、距離約 10 公尺內並維持一段時間的配對。
  • Detection: find vessel pairs within ~10 m of each other, at the same time, for a sustained period.
  • 本站旁靠偵測每 2 小時更新，並標記涉及制裁或身分異常的事件。
  • STS detection updates every 2 hours and flags events involving sanctions or identity anomalies.

船對船轉運（旁靠）是什麼？

船對船轉運（Ship-to-Ship Transfer，簡稱 STS），在中文裡常被稱為「旁靠」，指的是兩艘船在海上近距離並靠在一起，把貨物、燃油或漁獲從一艘船轉移到另一艘船，全程不需要進入任何港口。

這是航運業歷史悠久、完全正常的作業方式：大型油輪在外海把原油分裝給較小的船、母船在漁場接收漁船的漁獲、補給船為長期作業的船隊加油加水。問題在於——同一個動作，也可以用來隱匿貨物的真實來源與流向。

Two ships slowly close on each other in international waters, until they are almost touching, drifting side by side for hours. No port, no customs, no cameras on shore.

Cargo flows from one hull to the other. When they each sail away, no one can say for certain where that cargo originally came from.

What Is a Ship-to-Ship Transfer?

A Ship-to-Ship Transfer (STS), often called a "rendezvous" or "alongside" operation, is when two vessels lie close together at sea to move cargo, fuel, or catch from one ship to another — without ever entering a port.

This is a long-established, perfectly normal practice: large tankers decant crude into smaller ships offshore, motherships receive catch from fishing boats on the grounds, and bunker vessels refuel fleets working far from land. The problem is that the very same maneuver can be used to hide the true origin and destination of cargo.

旁靠如何被偵測？

旁靠很難從單一艘船的軌跡看出來——它是一種「兩艘船之間的關係」。本站透過 AIS 船位進行時空配對分析來找出它：

📍
空間鄰近兩艘船在某一時刻彼此距離極近（約 10 公尺內），近到幾乎是並靠。
⏱️
時間持續這種近距離狀態不是擦身而過，而是維持了一段時間（數十分鐘到數小時）。
🐢
低速或漂流轉運通常在低速或近乎停止的狀態下進行，而非全速航行中。

當一組船位同時滿足這些條件，系統就把它記為一次「旁靠事件」，並記錄參與的兩艘船、時間、位置與持續時間。

為什麼「會師」本身就是情報 就算我們不知道轉移了什麼貨物，「在公海特定地點、特定時間，A 船與 B 船並靠了 3 小時」這個事實本身，就足以成為後續比對與研判的有力線索——尤其當其中一艘船有制裁、身分變更或走暗紀錄時。

How Are STS Transfers Detected?

An STS is hard to see from a single ship's track — it is fundamentally a relationship between two vessels. This site finds it through spatio-temporal matching of AIS positions:

📍
Spatial proximityTwo vessels at some moment lie extremely close (within ~10 m) — close enough to be alongside.
⏱️
Sustained in timeThis closeness is not a passing crossing but lasts a sustained period (tens of minutes to hours).
🐢
Low speed or driftingTransfers usually happen at low speed or nearly stopped, not at full cruising speed.

When a set of positions meets all of these, the system records an "STS event," logging the two vessels involved, the time, location, and duration.

Why the Rendezvous Itself Is Intelligence Even without knowing what cargo moved, the simple fact that "at this place and time on the high seas, ship A lay alongside ship B for 3 hours" is a powerful lead for further analysis — especially when one of the vessels has a record of sanctions, identity changes, or going dark.

合法的旁靠 vs 可疑的旁靠

偵測到旁靠只是第一步。絕大多數的海上並靠都是正當作業，關鍵在於分辨「日常」與「異常」。

✅ 通常合法

  • 雙拖漁法：兩艘漁船共同拖一張網，全程必然並行。
  • 海上補給 / 加油：補給船為長期作業船隊提供燃油、淡水。
  • 母船接收漁獲：運搬船在漁場集中收取漁獲。
  • 港外等候 / 領港：在錨地附近短暫靠近。

⚠️ 值得警戒

  • 轉運時關閉 AIS：刻意在並靠期間走暗，隱匿行為。
  • 涉及制裁船隻：一方在 UN 制裁名單或影子船隊。
  • 身分異常：近期更換船名、MMSI 或虛報 IMO。
  • 地點與類型不合理：油輪在非加油區、敏感海域長時間並靠。

本站的旁靠偵測會把事件標記為「雙拖作業」或「可疑」，後者才會進一步納入威脅研判。

Legitimate STS vs Suspicious STS

Detecting an STS is only the first step. The vast majority of alongside operations are legitimate; the key is to tell routine from anomalous.

✅ Usually legitimate

  • Pair trawling: two boats towing one net necessarily run side by side.
  • Resupply / bunkering: support ships providing fuel and water to fleets.
  • Mothership collecting catch: reefers consolidating catch on the grounds.
  • Waiting / piloting: brief closeness near an anchorage.

⚠️ Worth scrutiny

  • AIS off during transfer: deliberately going dark while alongside.
  • Sanctioned vessel involved: one party on a UN list or shadow fleet.
  • Identity anomalies: recent name/MMSI change or false IMO.
  • Implausible place/type: a tanker alongside for hours in a non-bunkering, sensitive area.

This site's STS detection labels events as "pair-trawling" or "suspicious"; only the latter feeds further threat assessment.

為什麼旁靠與灰色地帶相關？

海上旁靠之所以成為灰色地帶的焦點，是因為它能在不留下港口紀錄的情況下移動貨物——這正是規避監管者最需要的能力。

🛢️
制裁規避受制裁國家（如俄羅斯、伊朗、北韓）的「影子船隊」以海上旁靠轉運石油，切斷貨物來源的可追溯性，再以「乾淨」的船進港。
📦
走私與洗貨透過多次轉運混淆貨物來源，逃避關稅、配額或禁運。
🎣
非法漁業轉載在海上把非法或越界捕撈的漁獲轉到運搬船，讓漁獲「漂白」後合法上岸。
🌐
可否認性整個過程發生在公海、無監視器、常配合走暗，天生具備模糊與可否認的特性——這正是灰色地帶行動的核心。

Why STS Matters for the Gray Zone

STS becomes a gray-zone focus because it can move cargo without leaving a port record — exactly the capability anyone evading oversight needs most.

🛢️
Sanctions evasion"Shadow fleets" of sanctioned states (Russia, Iran, North Korea) transship oil at sea to break the traceability of cargo origin, then send a "clean" ship into port.
📦
Smuggling & cargo launderingMultiple transfers obscure cargo origin to dodge tariffs, quotas, or embargoes.
🎣
Illegal-fishing transshipmentIllegal or cross-border catch is moved to a reefer at sea, "laundered," then landed as legal.
🌐
DeniabilityIt happens on the high seas, with no cameras and often with AIS off — inherently ambiguous and deniable, the core of gray-zone operations.

本專案如何判讀旁靠事件？

本站不把每一次旁靠都視為威脅。我們的目標是把海量正常作業濾掉，讓真正異常的少數浮現：

  1. 以時空配對掃描 AIS 軌跡，找出符合「近距離 + 持續 + 低速」的旁靠事件。
  2. 初步分類：雙拖漁法等典型合法型態標記為「雙拖作業」，其餘標記為「可疑」。
  3. 檢查參與船隻背景：是否涉及 UN 制裁、近期身分變更、或在事件期間走暗。
  4. 比對地點：是否發生在敏感海域、海底電纜附近或非常規加油區。
  5. 將可疑且具加重因素的旁靠納入威脅評分，列入監測清單供人工進一步研判。

即時的旁靠偵測結果可在 旁靠偵測頁 查看；完整評分邏輯見 本站方法論。

How This Project Reads STS Events

This site does not treat every rendezvous as a threat. The goal is to filter out the huge volume of routine operations so the genuinely anomalous few surface:

  1. Scan AIS tracks via spatio-temporal matching for events meeting "close + sustained + low speed."
  2. First-pass classification: typical lawful patterns like pair trawling are labeled "pair-trawling," the rest "suspicious."
  3. Check the vessels' background: UN sanctions, recent identity changes, or going dark during the event.
  4. Check the location: sensitive waters, near a submarine cable, or a non-standard bunkering area.
  5. Suspicious STS with aggravating factors feed the threat score and the monitoring list for human assessment.

Live STS results are on the STS detection page; the full scoring logic is in our methodology.

資料限制與免責聲明

  • 旁靠偵測不必然代表違法；多數為雙拖、補給等合法作業。
  • 偵測依賴 AIS 船位——若一方關閉 AIS，旁靠可能無法被看見，因此清單會低估真實事件數。
  • AIS 位置精度與轉發延遲可能造成距離誤判，產生偽陽性或漏判。
  • 「可疑」標記是風險排序，用於輔助人工研判，並非法律認定，也不指控任何具名船隻違法。

本頁為研究與教育用途，採 MIT 授權彙整公開資料。引用時請註明出處並一併說明上述限制。

Data Limitations & Disclaimer

  • An STS detection does not by itself indicate illegality; most are lawful pair-trawling, resupply, etc.
  • Detection relies on AIS positions — if one party switches off AIS, the STS may be invisible, so the list underestimates the true number of events.
  • AIS position accuracy and relay delay can misjudge distance, causing false positives or misses.
  • A "suspicious" label is a risk ranking to assist human analysis — not a legal finding, and not an accusation against any named vessel.

This page is for research and education, aggregating public data under the MIT License. When citing, please attribute the source and note the limitations above.

案例：影子船隊如何用旁靠「洗白」受制裁石油

公開的航運調查與制裁監測報告多次描述一套重複出現的手法。受制裁來源的原油，先由一艘「影子船隊」油輪裝載——這類油輪往往船齡偏高、由層層空殼公司持有、投保來路不明。

接著，這艘油輪駛往監管相對寬鬆的海域，例如東南亞外海或地中海特定灣區，與另一艘油輪近距離並靠。轉運過程中，雙方常關閉或假造 AIS，使外界難以把「載運來源貨物的船」與「最終進港的船」連在一起。

當載著「混合」或「來源已模糊」油品的第二艘船進港時，文件上的貨物來源已被切斷。這正是旁靠之所以成為制裁規避核心環節的原因：它在公海、無監視、可否認的條件下，重置了貨物的可追溯性。

為什麼盯住「會合」比盯住「貨物」更有效 即使無法登船檢驗貨物，「兩艘特定船在特定時間、特定地點並靠數小時」這個事實本身，就是可記錄、可比對、並能跨事件累積的情報——尤其當其中一艘船有制裁、走暗或身分變更紀錄時，這條線索的份量會明顯升高。

Case Study: How a Shadow Fleet "Launders" Sanctioned Oil via STS

Public shipping investigations and sanctions-monitoring reports repeatedly describe one recurring playbook. Crude oil from a sanctioned source is first loaded onto a "shadow fleet" tanker — typically an older hull, owned through layers of shell companies, with opaque insurance.

That tanker then sails to a loosely regulated patch of sea — for example off Southeast Asia or in particular Mediterranean gulfs — and lies alongside a second tanker. During the transfer both vessels often switch off or spoof their AIS, making it hard for outsiders to connect "the ship that carried the source cargo" to "the ship that eventually enters port."

When the second ship arrives carrying "blended" or origin-obscured oil, the documented cargo origin has been severed. This is exactly why STS sits at the heart of sanctions evasion: on the high seas, unobserved and deniable, it resets the traceability of the cargo.

Why Watching the Rendezvous Beats Watching the Cargo Even without boarding to inspect the cargo, the bare fact that "two specific ships lay alongside at a specific time and place for hours" is recordable, comparable, and cumulative across events — and its weight rises sharply when one of the vessels carries a record of sanctions, going dark, or identity changes.

旁靠偵測的盲點

本站的旁靠偵測仰賴 AIS 船位，因此有幾個先天限制必須誠實說明：

  • 雙方同時關閉 AIS 的轉運「看不見」——清單必然低估真實事件數。
  • AIS 位置造假（spoofing） 可讓兩船看似相距很遠，避開鄰近判定。
  • 極短暫的並靠可能只是擦身、領港或避碰，未必是轉運。
  • 「母船—子船」模式：大船在外海待命，小船多次往返接駁，單次距離與時長都不顯眼。

正因如此，旁靠偵測的定位是「產生待查線索」，而非「認定違法」。SAR 衛星可補捉部分關閉 AIS 的目標，但其覆蓋有時間與空間間隙，並非全天候、全海域。把多個來源（AIS、SAR、制裁名單、身分紀錄）交叉比對，才能讓真正可疑的少數浮現。

The Blind Spots of STS Detection

This site's STS detection relies on AIS positions, so several inherent limits must be stated honestly:

  • A transfer where both vessels switch off AIS is invisible — the list necessarily underestimates the true number of events.
  • AIS position spoofing can make two ships appear far apart, dodging the proximity test.
  • A very brief closeness may be a passing, piloting, or collision-avoidance maneuver — not a transfer.
  • The mothership–daughter pattern: a large ship waits offshore while small craft shuttle back and forth, so no single approach looks unusual in distance or duration.

For these reasons, STS detection is positioned to "generate leads to investigate," not to "establish illegality." SAR satellites can catch some AIS-off targets, but their coverage has spatial and temporal gaps — it is not all-weather, all-ocean. Only by cross-referencing multiple sources (AIS, SAR, sanctions lists, identity records) does the genuinely suspicious minority surface.

常見問題 FAQ

船對船轉運（旁靠）是什麼？
船對船轉運（Ship-to-Ship Transfer, STS），俗稱「旁靠」，是指兩艘船在海上近距離並靠在一起，將貨物、燃油或漁獲從一艘船轉移到另一艘船的行為，不需進港即可完成。
旁靠如何被偵測？
透過時空配對分析 AIS 船位：找出兩艘船在同一時段、彼此距離極近（約 10 公尺內）並維持一段時間的情況，即標記為一次旁靠事件。本站每 2 小時更新一次偵測結果。
旁靠一定是違法的嗎？
不是。許多旁靠是合法作業，例如雙拖漁法、海上補給、燃油加注或港外等候。是否可疑，取決於船舶類型、地點、是否關閉 AIS，以及是否涉及制裁或身分異常的船隻。
為什麼旁靠與灰色地帶和制裁規避相關？
受制裁國家的「影子船隊」常以海上旁靠轉運石油等貨物，避免進港被查驗、切斷貨物的來源追蹤。配合關閉 AIS，旁靠就成為隱匿物資流向的關鍵手法。
本站如何判讀旁靠事件？
本站區分「雙拖作業」與「可疑旁靠」，並把涉及制裁、身分變更或在敏感海域走暗的旁靠納入威脅評分，作為人工研判的線索，而非違法認定。

FAQ

What is a ship-to-ship (STS) transfer?
An STS transfer, or "rendezvous," is two vessels lying close together at sea to move cargo, fuel, or catch from one ship to another — completed without entering any port.
How are STS transfers detected?
By spatio-temporal matching of AIS positions: finding two vessels that, at the same time, are extremely close (within ~10 m) and stay that way for a sustained period. This site refreshes detections every 2 hours.
Is an STS transfer always illegal?
No. Many are lawful — pair trawling, resupply, bunkering, or waiting at anchor. Whether it is suspicious depends on vessel type, location, whether AIS was switched off, and whether a sanctioned or identity-anomalous vessel is involved.
Why does STS matter for the gray zone and sanctions evasion?
Shadow fleets of sanctioned states often transship oil and other cargo at sea to avoid port inspection and break the traceability of cargo origin. Combined with going dark, STS becomes a key tactic for hiding the flow of goods.
How does this site read STS events?
It separates "pair-trawling" from "suspicious" STS, and feeds those involving sanctions, identity changes, or going dark in sensitive waters into threat scoring — as a lead for human assessment, not a legal determination.
